message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., success/failure, yes/no) using a logistic function. The model estimates coefficients for each feature, and the output is interpreted as a probability between 0 and 1. If the probability exceeds a chosen threshold (commonly 0.5), the input is classified into one class; otherwise, it is classified into the other.
